[[Beastmaster Korg]] can be found in a northern section on the second level of [[Rragar's Menagerie]]. He can be seen standing at the top of a flight of stairs, seemingly alone. When approached, a group of [[Fleshreaver]]s spawn at the foot of the stairs.

Due to lacking a surname, it is not known which [[High Legion]] Beastmaster Korg belonged to, let alone which [[warband]] other then Rragar's  hypothetical Man warband.
